name: Payment Context 3
definition: Payment context in which the transaction is performed.

CardPresent.name: Card Present
CardPresent.definition: Indicates whether the transaction has been initiated by a card physically present or not.

CardholderPresent.name: Cardholder Present
CardholderPresent.definition: Indicates whether the transaction has been initiated in presence of the cardholder or not.

OnLineContext.name: On Line Context
OnLineContext.definition: On-line or off-line context of the transaction.

AttendanceContext.name: Attendance Context
AttendanceContext.definition: Human attendance at the POI location during the transaction.

TransactionEnvironment.name: Transaction Environment
TransactionEnvironment.definition: Indicates the environment of the transaction.

TransactionChannel.name: Transaction Channel
TransactionChannel.definition: Identifies the type of the communication channels used by the cardholder to the acceptor system.

AttendantMessageCapable.name: Attendant Message Capable
AttendantMessageCapable.definition: Indicates whether a message can be sent or not on an attendant display (attendant display present or not).

AttendantLanguage.name: Attendant Language
AttendantLanguage.definition: Language used to display messages to the attendant.

CardDataEntryMode.name: Card Data Entry Mode
CardDataEntryMode.definition: Entry mode of the card data.

FallbackIndicator.name: Fallback Indicator
FallbackIndicator.definition: Indicator of a card entry mode fallback.

AuthenticationMethod.name: Authentication Method
AuthenticationMethod.definition: Method used to authenticate a cardholder.
